title: Analysis code and intermediate result tables for cfDNA methylation signatures in pre-eclampsia

creators.name: Xie, Weixian
creators.affiliation: Department of Anesthesiology, Affiliated Qingyuan Hospital, Guangzhou Medical University, Qingyuan, Guangdong, China

description: Reproducible analysis pipeline for the manuscript 'Maternal leukocyte composition, not placental pathology, underlies pre-eclampsia-associated differences in plasma cell-free DNA methylation'. The repository contains numbered R and Python scripts, selected intermediate result tables, composed manuscript figures, and the manuscript source documents.
